whatIs.title: What is this online timer / stopwatch?
whatIs.description: A countdown timer and stopwatch that run right in your browser, no install needed. Use it for instant noodles, a 10-minute break, meetings and talks, or workout intervals. Fullscreen mode makes the digits readable from across a classroom or meeting room, and because time is calculated from the end time, switching tabs never makes it drift.

howToUse.title: How to use
items: 1. On the Timer tab, press 1, 3, 5, 10, 15 or 30 min to start right away, or enter hours, minutes and seconds and press Start (or Enter).
2. While running, use +1 min to extend, Space to pause/resume and R to reset. The remaining time also shows in the browser tab title.
3. Press Fullscreen (F) for big digits. Space and R keep working during a class or talk; press Esc to exit.
4. On the Stopwatch tab, press Lap (L) to record splits. You'll see each split, the fastest and slowest laps and the average, and can copy them as CSV.
5. Copy the share link to get an address with the same timer ready (e.g. /timer/?m=10). Because of autoplay rules, the person opening the link presses Start.

tips.title: Tips
items: Bookmark a share link to open a '10-minute timer' in one click. Your last duration and alert settings are remembered in this browser.
For classes and meetings, turn on fullscreen and 'Keep screen on' so the laptop display doesn't go dark.
If you'll be working in another tab, enable browser notifications so a pop-up appears along with the sound.
To alternate focus and breaks use the Pomodoro timer; for per-section talk timing use the presentation timer.

items.q: Is it still accurate in a background tab?
items.a: Yes. Instead of subtracting one every second, the timer stores the end time and compares it with the current time, so browser throttling of background tabs can't make it drift. The alarm is also scheduled for the end time and fires within about a second. If the computer goes to sleep the browser pauses, and the timer finishes as soon as it wakes.

Browsers block audio until you interact with the page (autoplay policy). The timer unlocks sound when you press Start, which is also why a shared link never starts on its own. Try 'Test sound'; if you hear nothing, check tab mute, system volume and your phone's silent mode (on iPhone, the silent switch mutes web audio).

Press the Fullscreen button or F to fill the screen with the digits. Space (start/pause) and R (reset) still work, and Esc or F exits. On browsers without fullscreen support, such as Safari on iPhone, a large overlay covers the page instead.

items.q: What happens if I close the browser?
items.a: Closing the tab or browser stops a running timer. Only your last duration and alert settings are saved on this device, so you can start the same time again right away.

items.q: Can I set more than an hour?
items.a: Yes, up to 99 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds. Minutes or seconds over 60 are added up automatically (e.g. 90 minutes = 1 hour 30 minutes).

routine.title: Sequential timer routine
routine.description: Run named stages such as exercise, rest, and preparation in order, with repeats.
routine.name: Routine name
routine.limits: 1–12 stages · 1–7,200 seconds per stage · 1–10 repeats · Up to 24 hours total · Names up to 40 characters
routine.editLocked: A running or paused routine cannot be edited. Reset the routine before editing stages or loading a saved routine.
routine.resetNotice: Routine reset. You can edit its settings or start again from the beginning.
routine.skipped: Skipped the current stage. Skipping does not play an alert.
routine.otherRunning: Pause the existing timer or stopwatch and dismiss any active alarm before starting or resuming a routine.
routine.runningElsewhere: A sequential routine is running. Pause or reset it below before using the timer or stopwatch.
routine.soundHint: Stage alerts use the timer's sound and vibration settings above. Skips are silent, and returning after several stages plays only one alert.
routine.backgroundHint: Uses actual elapsed time while this page stays open. Background alerts may be delayed. Closing the page ends the run; start it manually when you return.
routine.storageHint: Save up to 10 routine configurations in this browser. Running state and remaining time are not saved.
routine.deleteConfirm: Delete the saved routine “{name}”? Your current settings will stay as they are.
routine.loaded: Loaded “{name}”. Press Start routine to run it.

errors.corrupt: Saved routines could not be read, so the original data was preserved. You can still use the current routine.
errors.unsupported: This saved format is unsupported, so the original data was preserved. You can still use the current routine.
errors.unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. The change was not saved; check your storage settings.
errors.quota: There is not enough storage space to save the change. Existing routines are preserved.
errors.conflict: Another tab changed the saved list, so this action stopped. Your current settings are intact; reload the list and select again.
errors.invalid: Check names and durations: names 1–40 characters, 1–12 stages, 1–7,200 seconds each, 1–10 repeats, and no more than 24 hours total.
errors.limit: You can save up to 10 routines. Delete an unneeded saved routine first.
errors.duplicate: A routine with this name is already saved. Use another name or delete the existing saved routine.
